conventions: Use idiomatic Go and keep changes minimal.
Use go test ./... as the final module verification.
Use apply_patch for code edits and do not revert unrelated changes.

hard: Objective is to remove all project usages of nodetype.NodeType and replace them with string.
NodeDefinition.Type is already string and should remain string.
Keep behavior compatible; preserve node type string values start, task, and end.
Do not delete package nodetype unless it is clearly unused and tests pass.
soft: Prefer additive or local refactor over broad restructuring.
compatibility: Registry, NodeDescriptor, and Node.Type are public Go API surfaces and may affect consumers.
Compiler error text for unknown node types should remain compatible where practical.

patterns: FlowDefinition contains string node type definitions consumed by compiler.
Registry maps node type to NodeDescriptor and factories create CompiledNode values.
Tests use lightweight fake nodes implementing Node and CompiledNode interfaces.

key_components.name: Node interface
responsibility: Define runtime node identity, type, configuration, and execution contract.

key_components.name: FlowCompiler
responsibility: Resolve node descriptors from registry by NodeDefinition.Type.
Build compiled node graph and start-node list.

key_components.name: nodetype package
responsibility: Currently defines NodeType and start/task/end constants.
May become obsolete after string migration.

purpose: Primary owner of nodetype.NodeType public and internal registry usage.
Casts NodeDefinition.Type to nodetype.NodeType before registry lookup.
Test helper and registry setup use nodetype.NodeType and casts.
Engine test fake node and registry setup use nodetype.NodeType.
Design docs explicitly recommend nodetype.NodeType in registry examples.

patterns_found.name: Compiler registry lookup by definition type

gotchas.text: Removing nodetype constants may require replacing nodetype.StartNode/TaskNode usages even after NodeType is gone.
Plan files themselves may mention nodetype.NodeType; final grep should exclude docs/plan artifacts if checking repository history artifacts.
User or formatter may have changed define.go after previous turn; execution should read current files before editing.

rationale: Current define.go already defines Type string.
User objective is to replace nodetype.NodeType usages with string.

prior_decisions.decision: Do not plan unconditional package deletion.
rationale: Package nodetype may still provide constants until usage audit confirms removal is safe.
